svg.aria-label: Five data sources (chemical structure, protein interactions, gene expression, gene regulatory edges and, as future work, physiological MEA recordings) feed one multimodal and multiscale AI model, which returns two answers: the predicted MIE class of a compound from structure alone, and the probability that the hepatocyte tips to z-adversity instead of returning to z-homeo.
